checks.q: Is the state migration from v1 to v2 atomic or safely resumable?
Are user balances preserved exactly during token migration?
Is the old contract properly deprecated after migration?
Are migration deadlines clearly communicated and enforced?
Is the exchange rate between old and new tokens fair and fixed?
Are approval migrations handled to prevent old approvals from being exploited?
Is the migration contract's admin access properly limited and time-bounded?
Are LP tokens and staked positions migrated correctly?
